case_number: 2024 INSC 455; CIVIL APPEAL NO. _____/2024 [ARISING OUT OF SLP (CIVIL) NO .…. DIARY NO(s) 17623/2021]

parties.petitioner: Government Of NCT Of Delhi & Anr.

summary: Land acquisition lapsed under Section 24(2) of 2013 Act; physical possession not taken/partial compensation not paid; High Court correctly applied Pune Municipal Corporation precedent; Government's second appeal barred by res judicata; fraud allegation unfounded; merger doctrine applied; acquisition deemed lapsed under retrospective application of 2013 Act.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.24(2)
final_judgment: Special leave granted in all appeals except Group B.2 and Group D; condonation of delay ordered; High Court judgment upheld; acquisition deemed lapsed.
